items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know. I don't know when he switched. I don't know the year or when.

ctx.x: They were over there, yes? Yeah, yeah. We had a nice visit and she made a tape too like this. Talk about him.
When did he switch to the sliding trombone, Cornish?
